identityReview: Matched Charles H. Robbins, known as Chuck Robbins, Cisco chair and CEO, using corporate biography and SEC appointment filing. American identity supported by Wikipedia. Birth left unknown because published year is 1965 or 1966 and age statements alone do not establish a unique year.
lifeStatusEvidence: Cisco November 12, 2026 first-quarter earnings release quotes Chuck Robbins as chair and CEO on current results and AI infrastructure demand.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Read relevant passages of Cisco current executive biography, SEC May 2015 appointment and August 2024 restructuring filings, Splunk completion release, November 2026 earnings release, Business Roundtable January 2026 announcement and Wikipedia. University System of Georgia honorary-degree agenda was returned by search but full PDF returned 404; its graduation year is not adopted.
sourceReview.scope: Identity, education, sales career, distinct governance appointments, acquisition, workforce restructuring and recent activity.
corrections: Birth year not derived from SEC age 49 in May 2015 or age 60 in 2026 search results. Wikipedia explicitly gives 1965 or 1966. No unsupported exact date retained.

Cisco biography confirms mathematics bachelor’s degree with computer science concentration from UNC–Chapel Hill. This is not a separate computer-science degree or earned doctorate. Georgia Tech and High Point honorary doctorates do not establish a research doctorate. Graduation year omitted because primary PDF could not be opened.

SEC confirms December 1997 joining, October 2012 promotion to Senior Vice President Worldwide Field Operations. Sales and partner-organisation leadership is not sole invention of networking technology; Robbins is not a Cisco founder.

SEC says board acted May 1, 2015, with board membership effective then, while CEO appointment took effect July 26. May 4 is public announcement/filing date, not board action date. John Chambers remained chair and became executive chair.
December 11, 2017 chair election is separately confirmed in Cisco current biography, not assumed to coincide with July 2015 CEO transition.

March 18, 2024 Splunk release reports acquisition completed, distinct from September 2023 agreement and announcement. Future integration or revenue synergies are not treated as already achieved solely by closing.

August 14, 2024 SEC Item 2.05 describes a plan expected to affect approximately 7 percent of global workforce. Profile preserves anticipated scope, not an assertion all layoffs occurred on that date or that every change was personally executed by the CEO.

Business Roundtable January 13, 2026 announcement confirms continuing chair status. Earlier announced two-year term starting January 2024 must not be used to assert he ceased being chair in 2026. No unsupported extension date or length added.
November 12, 2026 release is Q1 fiscal 2027 for period ended October 24, 2026, not Q1 calendar 2027. Reported quarterly metrics, adjusted non-GAAP measures and future annual guidance remain distinct.
No promotional employer rankings, speculative personal wealth or unverified technical invention claims used. Team contributions and employee impacts are retained.
sourceReview.limits: AI authored and reviewed, not human/native-language certified. No financial audit or independent validation of corporate forecasts. Relevant source passages reviewed rather than entire financial statements.
